name: Companion OS Alpha Final
purpose: Unify Seed's remaining v2 foundation into one Companion OS Alpha: continuity, timeline, memory backend, document registry, OS migrations, OS bridge, command registry, trace engine, trust center, tool manifest v2, workflows, microagent council, repo-aware self-improvement, release manager, Seed World, Memory Garden, avatar state, voice session, cockpit, and v2 release gate.
honesty_boundary: Seed is not alive, conscious, sentient, or human. Seed may be companion-like through persistent local state, approved memory, rituals, quests, symbolic world state, voice output, avatar state, safe tools, and approval-gated self-improvement.
approval_rule: Read-only and diagnostic views can run when user invokes them. Risky local control, self-editing, file modification, tool execution, and sensitive memory require explicit approval through existing gates. Companion OS does not override older safety systems.
